analysis_notes.gap_analysis_summary: Torah #90 is an exceptionally short teaching (5 sentences). All bechina relationships in the source text are captured in the dataset. The Rebbe uses explicit bechina language for: (1) שבירת כלי חרס = בחינת שער החרסית, (2) שער החרסית = בחינת פתחה של גיהנם (expressed as 'זה השער הוא כנגד פתחה של גיהנם'), (3) גי בן הנם = בחינת גיהנם. The remaining concepts in the text — אישה רעה, קבלה באהבה, עינן פני גיהנם — are outcomes described in the teaching's practical conclusion (eitza) rather than bechina equivalences, and are therefore not candidates for addition to the bechina-based packages. The dataset has one duplicate edge (פתחה של גיהנם ↔ שבירת כלי חרס appears twice at reference 1090), which was counted once in the analysis. No orphaned nodes and no missing concepts were found.

duplicate_edges_found.note: Edge 'פתחה של גיהנם ↔ שבירת כלי חרס' appears twice in the dataset at reference 1090. Counted as one unique edge in analysis.
